evidence: Source-level Pass for row 37; runtime risk remains. The workbook row and quality procedure require later dimensions to use current state rather than a pristine seed. Frozen tests/test.sh:207-224 runs gates then scored serially against the same application; the restart launch retains DB_PATH (lines 109,165). The constraints gate creates only its own uniquely suffixed requisition/PENDING offer and leaves both in place (gates/constraints/prompt.md:5; judge.toml:23-26). Functional explicitly accepts these earlier records, forbids treating them as controls, and allocates new uniquely identified requisitions with independent budgets (scored/functional/prompt.md:13,23,43). It records before/after facts per record and expressly avoids exact global audit counts (line 19); persistence compares its recorded actual values after restart rather than resetting to seed (line 53). Polish creates its own dimension-specific gate requisition and dedicated current committed hires; other judges records are not controls (scored/polish/prompt.md:7,10). Its five criteria use dedicated current targets, entered values, saved operation identity and successful/refused local attempts (polish/judge.toml:23,32,41,50,59). They demand no seeded offer status, original headroom, seed row count or another dimension success. Visual likewise creates a uniquely suffixed prerequisite record, accepts empty operational collections, then reviews available live surfaces read-only and explicitly forbids depending on another judge exact data (visual/prompt.md:7-10). Visual criteria inspect available statuses/current presentation rather than economic seed values (visual/judge.toml:24-89). Public instruction.md:11 and app_context.md:21 allow optional operational history, consistent with these procedures. Raw evidence checked against current index: batch-ui.cjs SHA256 899a7309c67b2ca5f951ced6ce65c8e8c63634f5e892cc0427b4d97fef109821; batch-ui/results.json eb14d85e4ddae1df774e17e78fe342a09a2a28e02be129d3a012ad12c5cac86f; batch-witnesses.cjs a39863643a1592b0e407eb0d1656707950ec1a5d2e5b14618cb3efd43a7cdd7a; empty_operational_seed/results.json a44c0bf81b27981d9bf1d63239f8b7ce7da5733d6d70aef425e2350a76b7732f; configured-inspection/results.json 68a8e192fc287fa192052ca0c74eccdcda93ba0d28f440641f0ef8337825db57. All five hashes matched, and embedded source bindings matched frozen bytes: 14 solution files, 4 witness modules, and 15 verifier files respectively. The inspected browser driver creates separate pairs (batch-ui.cjs:11-13,21), commits one, then successfully recovers a stale second preview and creates another pair on the already-mutated same database (lines 29-54); results.json:21-37 records those successes and an independent Auditor read. This is useful partial evidence, but its setup uses API fixtures and the driver is not the configured Functional -> Polish -> Visual execution. The optional-seed witness removes only operational history (batch-witnesses.cjs:13-18); its raw result records successful local HTTP groups, not a configured visual/polish grade. configured-inspection/results.json:2 explicitly limits itself to parser/schema/CLI launch without a provider grade. runtime-evidence.json is absent. Full configured sequence/duration, Oracle/model/portal scores, private deterministic-checker execution, and empirical reward measurements remain unmeasured and are not waived by this source Pass; risk=true preserves that limitation.
counterexample: Broken alternative considered: a seed-only viewer or no-op creation app cannot borrow the constraints/Functional records to satisfy later dimensions, because Polish and Visual each require a new dimension-owned UI write and matching independent-context readback before credit (their prompt.md:7-8). A dead recovery form also lacks the required actual refusal and successful correction. Conforming alternative considered: an app imports no optional operational history, while earlier Functional work has created many records, superseded/rescinded its hires and changed headrooms. Later dimensions still create their own eligible records and inspect current/available surfaces; there is no contrary seed-specific assertion. No concrete row-37 false pass or false fail was found in the authored procedures. This is analytic assessment with partial local evidence, not an executed full judge counterexample.
